note: Rewritten from Oshima 1914, original in English (Annotationes Zoologicae Japonenses 8(3): 553–585). Description of a new species, the alate unknown (Imago unknown in the original); the type locality is Tarakan (Dutch Borneo), collected on 1913-5-23 by Kanehira. The original places the species in the subgenus Hirtitermes of Eutermes (now the genus Hirtitermes). The measurement table is badly damaged by OCR: the four rows for soldier body length and head width and for worker body length and head width are corrupted into nonsense (DOO THM. / BOOTA / CO TM. / I2 MM. in the original) and are not recorded; the legible values are transcribed with the original comma decimals (2,19 mm written as 2.19 mm). The soldier figure of Plate X, fig. 7 is not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The nearest relative of this species is Eutermes (Hirtitermes) hirtiventris Holmgren, but the head capsule of the soldier of the present species is densely covered with spine-like hairs, whereas that of the latter is bare.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum brownish yellow; rostrum slightly darker; antennae paler; abdominal tergites grey, sternites greyish yellow. The head, the base of the rostrum and the thorax are densely covered with stout spine-like hairs; the abdominal tergites bear two rows of stiff spine-like hairs. The head is broadly oval and short; the rostrum is stout and markedly elongate, its front surface forming a distinct arc with the front of the head; the basal antennal segment is projecting; the antennae have 13 segments, the segments elongate, segment 3 as long as segment 1 and more than twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 less than half as long as segment 3 and as long as segment 5; the pronotum is saddle-shaped with the middle of the anterior margin concave; the legs are slender and long; the cerci are stout and pointed. Measurements: head with rostrum length 2.19 mm; head length without rostrum 1.22 mm; pronotum width 0.53 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Colour and pilosity as in the soldier, with the pronotum slightly paler; the labrum is densely covered with microtrichia. The head is pentagonal and flat, with rounded corners; the cranial sutures are distinct and whitish; the fontanelle is triangular; the base of the clypeus is very short, four times as wide as long, and slightly swollen; the antennae have 14 segments, segment 3 less than twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segments 2 and 5; the pronotum is saddle-shaped and the middle of its anterior margin is almost not concave. Measurements: pronotum width 0.69 mm.
